rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of Vanguard drone ships
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of Vanguard drone ships.

rules.key: A Vanguard drone ship must be armed with one weapon chosen
rules.text: A Vanguard drone ship must be armed with one weapon chosen from the following list:
rules.why: The exclusion is implemented: the weapon rows share a group id derived from the attachment target, so choosing one switches the others off. THAT a weapon must be taken is left to the player - the app cannot choose which.

rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of Kraken
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of Kraken.

rules.key: A Kraken must be armed with one weapon chosen
rules.text: A Kraken must be armed with one weapon chosen from the following list:
rules.why: The same exclusive group as on the drone ship, separately.

rules.key: Tyranids do not follow the normal squadron rules
rules.text: Tyranids do not follow the normal squadron rules when forming up the fleet.
rules.why: An introduction to the next sentence.

rules.text: Vanguard drone ships and Kraken may be deployed in squadrons of 6 to 12 models.
rules.why: Two reasons why this is written by hand: the book writes the range as a word ('6 to 12') and not with a dash, and the sentence is in its own SQUADRONS section, which has no ships at all - so the rule must be pointed at the VANGUARD DRONE SHIPS and KRAKEN sections. Until 7.9.2026 the browser followed the section the rule is in, not the one it concerns; that was fixed too.

rules.key: You may combine the two types in a single squadron
rules.text: You may combine the two types in a single squadron if you wish.
rules.why: The app's escort skwadron is one list row multiplied by the number of ships, so a mixed skwadron must be entered as two rows. The size check then looks at each separately and may complain about a too-small skwadron although the total is legal.

rules.key: Leadership value equal to the number of vessels remaining
rules.text: Escort squadrons in a Tyranid Vanguard fleet each have a Leadership value equal to the number of vessels remaining in the squadron (up to a maximum of 10).
rules.why: Leadership changes during the game; not fleet building.

rules.key: may take a Leadership test at the start of each turn in order to override their Instinctive Behaviour
rules.text: Escort squadrons in a Tyranid Vanguard fleet may take a Leadership test at the start of each turn in order to override their Instinctive Behaviour, just as if they were in range of a hive ship.

rules.key: No hive ship may ever have more than three different special refits
rules.text: No hive ship may ever have more than three different special refits, no cruiser more than two and no escort more than one.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. On the Vanguard list only escorts: max 1. The earlier gap: the bio-enhancements' count limit by ship type. The app does not count how many different refits one ship has, so the limit is left to the player. It reads BIO-ENHANCEME

rules.key: no single bio-enhancement may be granted more than once
rules.text: With the exception of reinforced carapace and extra spore cysts, no single bio-enhancement may be granted more than once.
rules.why: The structure allows every row once (a row is take/off), so the main rule holds by itself; the exceptions (carapace and spore cysts several times) cannot be bought in v1 - repeatable list upgrades are a v1.1 feature (docs/history/registry/BACKLOG.md).

rules.key: Tyranids cannot use the torpedo refits available to other races
rules.text: Because the equivalent of Tyranid torpedoes are always boarding torpedoes, Tyranids cannot use the torpedo refits available to other races.
rules.why: The ban concerns other factions' refit tables, which this list does not offer at all.

notes: The list has no hive ships and no hull ships at all - only the Vanguard drone ship and the Kraken. The book gives the reason on page 429: 'Vanguard fleets lack hive ships, but do allow their vessels to have some degree of autonomy.'

The Kraken's fifth weapon is called 'Torpedoes' (+15) on this list, but on the Hive list on page 431 exactly the same row is 'Boarding torpedoes' (+15). The difference is the book's own; both are left in the book's wording.

The bio-enhancements are on the book's pages 426-427 and not on the list page. They are copied to both tyranid lists as a section of their own; the note's page reference was wrong until 7.9.2026 (429-431).
All of the ship's weapons exclude each other. Before 7.9.2026 the app allowed taking them at once, which made an 80 point ship out of a 25 point Kraken.
